vuln.name: Spring Boot Actuator Endpoints Exposed
vuln.description: Spring Boot Actuator endpoints (such as /actuator, /env, /heapdump, /jolokia, /trace) are enabled and reachable without authentication. Several expose sensitive runtime data or allow interaction with the application.
vuln.impact: Endpoints like /env and /heapdump leak secrets (database credentials, session tokens, environment variables); /jolokia and /shutdown can lead to remote code execution or denial of service.
vuln.recommendation: Disable or restrict actuator endpoints in production. Expose only /health over the management port on a protected network, require authentication, and never expose /env, /heapdump, /jolokia, or /shutdown publicly.
